title: Aiden
lines: He has many things ahead of him in his destiny.
He doesn't know his powers yet.
But people around him are pushing him on to bigger and better things.
He has a mum who works tirelessly.
He has a sister who annoys him (she's obviously just doing her job).
He has an old grandad who looks young, and who is there to guide him and help him with different things in his life.
Watch this space. Aiden has a fantastic future.
